title: Table #1 Broken during assembly; Table #2 OK
text:
Table #1 Broken during assembly; Table #2 OK. Table #1
The four legs must be attached to the table top and the shelf. Each leg has a wooden bracket into which you place and turn a long screw. Ideally, the leg will end-up screwed to the table top and flush with both sides of the table top. As I was attaching the second leg, the wooden bracket came apart from the table leg, thus making it impossible to attach the leg to the top of the table. It is a very pretty table but evidently not well made as I am an older lady, almost age 70, and was not using a great deal of force. Even without the problem with the broken bracket, it was a struggle to get both the first and the second legs attached because the holes were not properly aligned.

Table #2
A replacement table was sent. Assembly was quick and easy.
